FAQ

Frequently
Asked Questions

Many matters begin with an initial consultation at no charge. Contact our office to confirm availability and scheduling for your case type.

Fees depend on the type of matter. Some cases — such as personal injury — may be handled on contingency, meaning no fee unless we recover for you. Other matters may involve flat fees, retainers, or hourly billing. We explain all fee structures upfront, clearly.

Bring any court papers, contracts, police reports, insurance letters, photographs, messages, or documents related to your situation. The more context you can provide, the better we can assess your options.

Yes. Contact us as soon as possible so we can review your deadlines and determine how quickly we can assist. Time-sensitive matters are handled with priority.
